column3: “The house of books” is rendered “the archives.”
“Citadel” is rendered “fortress.”
NASB supplies “Concerning” and “being.”
“Stone of rolling” is rendered “huge stones.” NASB does not render “new” with timber, and “the house of the king” is rendered “the royal treasury.”
“Let it go … to its place” is rendered “brought to their places.”
“Far be from there” is rendered “keep away from there.”
“On its place” is rendered “on its site.”
The Aramaic reads “elders of the Jews”; NASB has “elders of Judah.” “That not to make cease” is rendered “without delay.”
NASB adds “anointing” with oil; “that not negligence” is rendered “without fail.”
“Soothing offerings” is rendered “acceptable sacrifices.”
“Be lifted up, let him be impaled” is rendered “he shall be impaled.”
“Stretch out his hand to violate” is rendered “attempts to change it.”
NASB supplies “the decree”; “accordingly diligently” is rendered “with all diligence.”
“Building and prospering” is rendered “were successful in building,” and “decree of the God of Israel” as “command.”
“Brought forth” is rendered “completed.”
“The people of exile” is rendered “the exiles.”
“He-goats of goats” is rendered “male goats.”
“Classes” is rendered “orders.” This is the last Aramaic verse of this section.
The text returns to Hebrew. “The children of the exile” is rendered “the exiles.”
“The passover” is rendered “the Passover lamb.”
NASB supplies “to join them” and “the Passover.”
“To make strong their hands” is rendered “to encourage them.”
